text: On November 4, 2024, Xcel Energy Inc., a Minnesota corporation ( Xcel Energy ), entered into separate forward sale agreements with each of Barclays Bank PLC and Bank of America, N.A., each in its capacity as a forward purchaser (collectively, the Forward Purchasers ), relating to an aggregate of 18,320,610 shares of Xcel Energy s common stock, par value $2.50 per share (each a Forward Sale Agreement and, collectively, the Forward Sale Agreements ). and Barclays Bank PLC, in its capacity as a Forward Purchaser. and Bank of America, N.A., in its capacity as a Forward Purchaser.
